plain: Marriage between members of different families.

webster.text: Marriage between two families, where each takes one and gives another.

example.quote: Do not these, and the intercourse and intermarriage between the people of the different states, invite them in the strongest manner to union ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
